text_block_list.name: Orfe & Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
—Stay Gold. Stand by me. —SteGo. Choose 
me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Then I'll pick both. That settles it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hold on a sec... Who answers 
instantly without even hearing what it is?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. It's her celebration. If she 
says both, then it's both.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
An auspicious occasion... Ah, you mean 
this is a birthday present for me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You didn't even realize? ...Geez, you're 
as crazy as ever.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, you're really okay with it, right? 
We're about to celebrate your birthday, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own way. But whichever 
you pick, it's high risk, high return... 
Knowing that, are you going to go for 
both?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. With the two of them hosting, I 
doubt I'll ever be bored...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I won't brush aside your consideration for 
me. My only concern is whether it will be 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Cease your foolish pondering. I shall go 
first. ...By the way, can you swim through 
midair?
